empty.title: Nothing selected
empty.hint: Click a part on the canvas to see its values, pins and position.

identity.label: Label
identity.refdesInvalid: Start with a letter, then letters and digits, up to 16 characters.
identity.refdesTaken: {refdes} is already used by another part.

values.none: This part has no values to set.

value.nan: That is not a number. Try 330, 4k7 or 0.33k.
value.unit: That unit does not fit here. This value is in {unit}.

position.notPlaced: This part is not on the current view.

nets.none: No nets yet. Draw a wire between two pins to make one.

refuse.last-board: The only board in the project cannot be deleted.
refuse.read-only: This project is open read only, so it cannot be changed here.

deleted.one: One item deleted. Undo brings it back.
deleted.other: {count} items deleted. Undo brings them back.

copy.nothing: Select at least one part to copy.

paste.nothing: Nothing to paste. Copy something first.
